_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — Accounts Payable (Core). Adds Payee, APTransaction, DunningNotice, PaymentRun schemas with x-openregister-lifecycle and x-openregister-aggregations. Mirrors the AR core. Consumes OR dunning-workflow (ADR-022) and OR scheduled-workflow for the issued → overdue transition (ADR-031 path 2). Sub-ledger materialises balanced GLTransaction via the T1 JournalEntry pattern. PaymentRun re-established as the canonical batch-payment schema (consolidate-accounts-payable). Seed data ships Dutch suppliers + a ZZP freelancer + a government payee + AP invoices spanning lifecycle states + an approved PaymentRun.

Payee.title: Payee
Payee.description: Canonical "anyone we pay" master for accounts payable + — covers suppliers, vendors, AND freelancers (Dutch ZZP'ers / sole traders / contractors), plus government payees. Holds party contact details, payment terms, a structured bankAccount object (IBAN + BIC/SWIFT + account holder), payeeType, folded financial fields (creditLimit, apBalance), dunning policy reference, and default expense account. Folds in the retired VendorFinancialProfile duplicate. Symmetric to CustomerMaster on the AR side. Per + ADR-024 (registers, not parallel PHP tables) + ADR-022 (consumes OR contact abstraction when available via contactRef).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Vendor master register; every create / update / lifecycle transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022.

vendorNumber.description: Stable vendor identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied; never auto-generated.
vendorNumber.title: Vendor Number

payeeType.description: Kind of party we pay. supplier/vendor = trading companies; freelancer = Dutch ZZP'er / sole trader; contractor = subcontracted party; government = public-sector payee; other = anything else. The AP module treats every payeeType as a payable party.
payeeType.title: Payee Type

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets APTransaction.dueDate on creation per).
paymentTermDays.title: Payment Term Days

defaultExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default expense coding on AP invoices.
defaultExpenseAccountNumber.title: Default Expense Account Number

bankAccount.description: Payee bank account for outgoing SEPA payments. Folds the retired VendorFinancialProfile iban/bic into a structured object. NOTE: bic IS the ISO 9362 SWIFT code (a "SWIFT code" and a BIC are the same identifier) — no separate swift field is modelled. Non-SEPA / cross-border international payments (non-IBAN account numbers, intermediary/correspondent banks) are OUT OF SCOPE here — a future capability; this object models SEPA IBAN/BIC only.

iban.description: Payee IBAN for outgoing SEPA payments. Read by the payment-run SEPA export as the creditor account.
iban.title: IBAN

bic.description: Bank ISO 9362 BIC / SWIFT code (same identifier). Creditor agent for the SEPA export.
bic.title: BIC

accountHolderName.description: Name on the bank account, if it differs from the payee legal name.
accountHolderName.title: Account Holder Name

bankAccount.title: Bank Account

creditLimit.description: Maximum outstanding AP balance permitted for this payee. Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile.
creditLimit.title: Credit Limit

apBalance.description: Current open accounts-payable balance for this payee (derived open-AP total; mirrors the vendorOpenApBalance aggregation). Folded in from the retired VendorFinancialProfile.
apBalance.title: AP Balance

creditTerms.description: Free-text payment terms or reference to OR terms record.
creditTerms.title: Credit Terms

dunningPolicyRef.description: FK to OR dunning-workflow policy record if the extension is stable per ADR-022; else null. Drives reminder cadence from the overdue state.
dunningPolicyRef.title: Dunning Policy Ref

country.title: Country
country.description: The country name or ISO code.

email.description: Primary contact email for remittance advice and queries.
email.title: Email

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Symmetric to AR. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.
contactRef.title: Contact Ref

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this vendor record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Vendor master lifecycle state. blocked: new AP invoices cannot transition from received to issued; archived: historical reference only.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

active.label: Active
active.description: Vendor is active; AP invoices may be received and posted.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Vendor is blocked; new AP invoices cannot transition received → issued.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Vendor is archived for historical reference; no new invoices may be drafted.

block.label: Block vendor
block.description: Suspend new AP invoicing for this vendor (e.g. credit hold or dispute).

archive.label: Archive vendor
archive.description: Archive vendor after all open AP invoices are settled or written off.

APTransaction.title: AP Transaction
APTransaction.description: Accounts payable sub-ledger invoice recording vendor billing and payment obligation. Posting (issued transition) materialises one balanced GLTransaction per T1 (credit AP payable, debit expense per lines). Lifecycle: draft → received → issued → paid with partially-paid / overdue / disputed / written-off / voided branches. The issued → overdue transition fires via OR ScheduledWorkflow (ADR-031 path 2 — no PHP cron job). Aged-payables aggregations (detail / summary / timeline) declared inline. Sub-ledger linkage: every GLLine emitted from issue or write-off carries subLedgerType=ap + subLedgerRef=<APTransaction UUID> (scenario).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (receive / issue / match / dispute / overdue / write-off / void) and every header/line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022. Audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for the AP write-off scenario.

invoiceNumber.description: Vendor invoice number. Unique per administration + vendorId (scenario 2).
invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number

vendorId.description: FK to Payee UUID (or slug). Resolves to the vendor record carrying paymentTermDays and dunningPolicyRef.
vendorId.title: Vendor ID

invoiceDate.description: Date the vendor issued the invoice.
invoiceDate.title: Invoice Date

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from invoiceDate + Payee.paymentTermDays on receipt; operator overrideable.
dueDate.title: Due Date

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only (EUR); T5 adds multi-currency.
currency.title: Currency

totalAmount.description: Total amount including tax in administration base currency. Integer-cent precision applied per ADR-031 money rules. Credit memos are separate journal types, not negative totals.
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

taxAmount.description: VAT/BTW amount. T3 adds automated reverse-charge logic; T2 carries the field for reporting.
taxAmount.title: Tax Amount

lines.description: Invoice line breakdown. Each line maps to one GL expense account.

amount.description: Line amount net of VAT in administration base currency.
amount.title: Amount

taxCode.description: Tax code for this line (e.g. BTW21, BTW9, BTW0, VERLEGD).
taxCode.title: Tax Code

lines.title: Lines

sourceDocumentUri.description: docudesk FK URI per bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration. Points to the uploaded vendor invoice PDF.
sourceDocumentUri.title: Source Document URI

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once the invoice is issued (sub-ledger linkage).
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

writeOffReason.description: Operator-authored audit-trailed reason for write-off. Required on the writeOff lifecycle transition.
writeOffReason.example: Vendor administratie afgewikkeld; restant oninbaar per leveranciersbericht 2026-06-01.
writeOffReason.title: Write Off Reason

writeOffGlTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the compensating GLTransaction emitted on write-off (debit AP payable, credit bad-debt recovery/write-off expense). Per.
writeOffGlTransactionId.title: Write Off GL Transaction ID

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for GL posting (resolved on issue transition guard 2).
periodId.title: Period ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this AP invoice.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: AP invoices retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

received.label: Received
received.description: Vendor invoice physically received and recorded; awaiting approval/posting. Vendor invoice-number uniqueness already enforced.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Header immutable. Balanced GLTransaction materialised; awaiting payment match.

partially-paid.label: Partially paid
partially-paid.description: One or more bank-reconciliation matches applied; cumulative matched amount is less than totalAmount.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank-reconciliation engine. Terminal state for the happy path.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. OR dunning-workflow drives reminder cadence from this state.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Operator placed payment-match pursuit on hold pending vendor-raised dispute investigation.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Vendor restant uncollectible / waived; compensating GL posting emitted. Terminal state.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Issued invoice voided. The materialised issue GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1.

receive.label: Receive invoice
receive.description: Operator records vendor invoice receipt. Guard: vendor invoice number unique per (administrationId, vendorId) scenario 2.
receive.x-adr-031-exception: Single-method guard pending OR's unique-key extension stabilisation. Documented per ADR-031 §'PHP guards remain a legitimate seam' and the spec's REQ-AP-005 fallback clause.

issue.label: Issue / post invoice
issue.description: Operator approves and posts the AP invoice. Guards: (1) balanced materialisation per T1; (2) FiscalPeriod open; (3) Payee.lifecycleState=active. Actions: (a) materialise one balanced GLTransaction (debit expense per line, credit AP payable account); (b) set glTransactionId back-reference; (c) set periodId from invoiceDate.

matchFull.label: Match full payment
matchFull.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch. Guard: cumulative matched amount = totalAmount.

matchPartial.label: Match partial payment
matchPartial.description: Operator confirms a bank-reconciliation ReconciliationMatch where matched amount < totalAmount.

markOverdue.label: Mark overdue
markOverdue.description: Scheduled lifecycle action fires when today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. Triggered by OR ScheduledWorkflow + ADR-031 path 2 — NOT a shillinq *Job PHP class.

x-scheduled-workflow.description: Daily 01:00 sweep evaluates open AP invoices and transitions issued|partially-paid → overdue when today > dueDate. Per ADR-031 §'Background jobs that walk an object queue' path 2.

dispute.label: Dispute invoice
dispute.description: Operator marks invoice as disputed. Payment-match pursuit pauses pending resolution.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Vendor-raised dispute resolved; payment-match pursuit resumes.

writeOff.label: Write off
writeOff.description: Operator in role controller writes off the residual balance. Action: materialise a compensating balanced GLTransaction (debit AP payable account, credit bad-debt recovery / write-off account). Audit-trailed reason required. Sets writeOffGlTransactionId back-reference.

void.label: Void invoice
void.description: Operator voids the issued invoice. Guard: materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1.

dunning.description: Per the dunning cadence (reminder-1 / reminder-2 / formal-notice / collection) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension. The policy referenced via Payee.dunningPolicyRef drives DunningNotice creation from the overdue state. If OR's extension is not yet stable at implementation time, ADR-031's exception path applies: OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\APGuard ships a single-method fallback documented in the spec.

agedPayablesDetail.description: Aged Payables Detail report — per-invoice breakdown grouped by vendor and due-date bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided. BLOCKED (cross-tab): OpenRegister's aggregation engine honours only a single-field groupBy ({field: <name>}) today — this multi-field groupBy [vendorId, dueDateBucket] plus the buckets/return projection are INERT engine-side and must not be read as a working capability. Tracked by openregister#432 (honour multi-field groupBy); the shillinq spend-analytics feature ships single-dimension views against the honoured path meanwhile.

agedPayablesSummary.description: Aged Payables Summary report — vendor totals grouped by aging bucket. Excludes paid / written-off / voided. BLOCKED (cross-tab): the multi-field groupBy [vendorId, agingBucket] and the aggregate/buckets/return projection maps are INERT — OpenRegister honours only a single-field groupBy ({field: <name>}) today. Tracked by openregister#432.

agedPayablesTimeline.description: Aged Payables Timeline report — payment due dates with amounts and vendor summary. Excludes paid / written-off / voided.

vendorOpenApBalance.description: Per-vendor open AP balance used by Vendor detail view and pre-payment-run checks. Aggregates open (state in issued/partially-paid/overdue/disputed) APTransaction totals by vendorId.

message.nl: Deze inkoopfactuur staat in Shillinq. Openen?
message.en: This supplier invoice is in Shillinq. Open it?

message.nl: Deze factuur is vervallen in Shillinq. Openen?
message.en: This invoice is overdue in Shillinq. Open it?

DunningNotice.title: Dunning Notice
DunningNotice.description: Per-AP-invoice dunning timeline record. One row per reminder dispatched against one APTransaction in the overdue state. Reminder cadence (reminder-1 at +14d, reminder-2 at +30d, formal-notice at +45d, collection at +60d — all customisable per administration via OR dunning-workflow policy) is owned by OR's dunning-workflow extension, NOT by an app-local PHP service (ADR-022 anti-pattern). This register is a thin audit-trail of what OR's engine emitted.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Dunning-notice timeline; every dispatch and acknowledgement is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022.

reminderLevel.description: Dunning escalation level. Customisable cadence via OR dunning-workflow policy referenced from Payee.dunningPolicyRef.
reminderLevel.title: Reminder Level

dispatchedBy.description: Actor that dispatched the reminder. 'system' if emitted by OR's scheduled-workflow; otherwise the operator user-id.
dispatchedBy.title: Dispatched By

templateRef.description: FK to OR notification template used for the dispatch.
templateRef.title: Template Ref

acknowledgedAt.description: When the vendor acknowledged the notice (e.g. promise-to-pay or dispute response).
acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged At

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this dunning notice.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

PaymentRun.title: Payment Run
PaymentRun.description: A batch of approved Payee payments (consolidate-accounts-payable). Groups open AP invoices into a single outgoing payment instruction with a declarative lifecycle draft → approved → exported → reconciled. Approval (RBAC controller) is a hard gate before export — there is NO direct draft → exported transition. The actual SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank-file GENERATION is the separate payment-run-sepa-export change (writes exportedFileRef); this schema models only the batch + its lifecycle. Each paymentLines[] entry references one Payee + one APTransaction. bankAccount.iban / bankAccount.bic on the referenced Payee are the SEPA creditor source of truth.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Payment-batch register; every create / approve / export / reconcile transition is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel + ADR-022. Approval and export are the auditable control points before money leaves the administration.

runNumber.description: Stable batch identifier unique per administration. Operator-supplied.
runNumber.title: Run Number

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment run.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

executionDate.description: Requested execution date (ISO 20022 RequestedExecutionDate) for the batch.
executionDate.title: Execution Date

debtorAccountIban.description: IBAN of the administration's own (debtor) bank account the batch is paid from. SAFE placeholder in seed data.
debtorAccountIban.title: Debtor Account IBAN

status.description: Mirror of lifecycleState for list/filter convenience; the canonical state machine is x-openregister-lifecycle on lifecycleState.
status.title: Status

totalAmount.description: Sum of all paymentLines[].amount in the run currency. Integer-cent precision per ADR-031 money rules.
totalAmount.title: Total Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only (EUR).
currency.title: Currency

paymentLines.description: One line per Payee payment in the batch. Each line references a Payee and the AP invoice being settled.

payeeId.description: FK to Payee UUID / slug being paid.
payeeId.title: Payee ID

payeeName.description: Denormalised payee name for display / remittance.
payeeName.title: Payee Name

creditorIban.description: Creditor (payee) IBAN, sourced from the referenced Payee.bankAccount.iban. SAFE placeholder in seed data.
creditorIban.title: Creditor IBAN

amount.description: Line payment amount in the run currency.
amount.title: Amount

remittanceInfo.description: Unstructured or structured remittance reference (ISO 20022 RmtInf) — typically the vendor invoice number.
remittanceInfo.title: Remittance Info

apTransactionRef.description: FK to the APTransaction UUID / slug this line settles.
apTransactionRef.title: AP Transaction Ref

paymentLines.title: Payment Lines

exportedFileRef.description: FK / URI to the generated SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file. Written by the separate payment-run-sepa-export change on the export transition; null until exported.
exportedFileRef.title: Exported File Ref

exportedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was exported to a bank file.
exportedAt.title: Exported At

reconciledAt.description: Timestamp the batch was reconciled against the bank statement.
reconciledAt.title: Reconciled At

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Batch under construction; payment lines may be added/removed.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Batch approved by a controller; immutable and ready for export. Hard gate before money leaves the administration.

exported.label: Exported
exported.description: SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file generated (payment-run-sepa-export change); exportedFileRef set.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Batch reconciled against the bank statement; terminal state.

approve.label: Approve payment run
approve.description: Controller approves the batch. Four-eyes segregation of duties (payment-run-four-eyes): the approver MUST differ from whoever prepared the batch — enforced server-side by FourEyesPaymentRunGuard, which derives the preparer from OpenRegister's immutable audit trail (ADR-022) and fails closed when the preparer is indeterminate. There is NO direct draft → exported transition. Approval is the control point before money leaves the administration.

export.label: Export payment run
export.description: Generate the SEPA pain.001 / CSV bank file (payment-run-sepa-export change) and set exportedFileRef + exportedAt. Only an approved batch can be exported. Duplicate-payment control (payment-control-guards): PaymentRunDuplicateGuard rejects the export server-side when any paymentLines[].apTransactionRef settles an AP invoice that is already paid, or is already queued in another open/executed PaymentRun (draft/approved/exported). Export is the last declarative choke point before money leaves — the approve transition's requires slot is occupied by FourEyesPaymentRunGuard and the OR lifecycle engine resolves a single requires guard per transition. Fails closed on any indeterminate check.

reconcile.label: Reconcile payment run
reconcile.description: Match the exported batch against the bank statement and set reconciledAt. Terminal.
